news.title: Widerwillen Launch
news.body: Welcome to Widerwillen. Battle stages, collect rewards, summon units, and grow your account.

news.title: Event Battles Added
news.body: Events now use real battle scenes with victory rewards and account-level scaling.

news.title: Trade Shop Open
news.body: Use the Trade Shop to exchange coins, crystals, and relics through rotating offer categories.

news.title: Daily Login Rewards
news.body: Daily login rewards are now available. Check in once per day to claim your reward.
